sub_agendas_items.title: Migration from the E911 Network to the NG9-1-1 Network

attachments.attachment_title: 5- MIGRATION FROM THE E911 NETWORK TO THE NG9-1-1 NETWORK F.pdf

motions.motion_text:
That the Ottawa Police Service Board delegate authority to the Chief of Police for the purchase of equipment and professional services from Netagen for the future migration of the 9-1-1 connections for both the Ottawa Police Service (OPS) and Ottawa Fire Services (OFS) from the legacy Enhanced 9-1-1 (E911) network to the new Next Generation 9-1-1 (NG9-1-1) network, as mandated by the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (CRTC), for the amount of $912,734.56 before applicable taxes.
Withdrawn
